newsitem.title: USA: Seagull preparing to produce Egyptian find.
newsitem.headline: Seagull preparing to produce Egyptian find.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said it is applying for development lease for its South Hurghada exploration concession in Egypt.
Seagull said the first exploration test drilled since it purchased the South Hurghada concession, the Abu Marwa 1, has recovered 28-degree gravity oil and is being completed as a future producer.

The new discovery offsets two successful South Hurghada wells drilled by the former owner in the nearby Wadi el Sahl area. The earlier discoveries tested oil at flow rates of 3,900 and 1,040 barrels per day, respectively.

Seagull said it plans to develop both production areas on the 100 percent owned concession. Trucking of oil production could begin before year-end 1997 while permanent production facilities are being designed and installed.
It said an additional exploratory test is scheduled in the Wadi el Sahl area in the second quarter.
